cryptoTrack.positions.title: DeFi positions
cryptoTrack.positions.pageHint: What the connected addresses hold inside protocols: pools, collateral and staking. Read from the network, never typed in.
cryptoTrack.positions.detailHint: One position whole: what went in, what it is worth, how the result is made up.
cryptoTrack.positions.putIn: Put in at the price of the deposit
cryptoTrack.positions.legend: ≈ before a number means the adapter marks it approximate. A dash means the figure is not known (no price for a token, no history); it is never zero. Accruals of a supply or a stake are already inside the worth and the net result, and are not added a second time. Impermanent loss is shown for reference only.
cryptoTrack.positions.approximateMark: Approximate: the adapter could not read it exactly
cryptoTrack.positions.actions.label: Position actions
cryptoTrack.positions.actions.operations: The operations list for this protocol and network
cryptoTrack.positions.empty.title: No DeFi positions yet
cryptoTrack.positions.empty.description: Positions are read from the chain at the addresses of your wallets: liquidity in Uniswap, supplies and loans in Aave, staking in Lido. Add a wallet address and they appear after its first sync.
cryptoTrack.positions.reason.noPrice: No price for {tokens}: the figure is unknown, not zero
cryptoTrack.positions.reason.noHistory: No history for this position yet: the figure is unknown, not zero
cryptoTrack.positions.reason.notRead: The adapter could not read this figure: it is unknown, not zero
cryptoTrack.positions.reason.notApplicab: Does not exist for this kind of position
cryptoTrack.positions.reason.noRate: No rate: nothing was put in, or no time has passed
cryptoTrack.positions.banner.noPriceTitl: No price for {tokens}: a dash instead of a sum, not a zero
cryptoTrack.positions.banner.noPrice: Without a price the worth, the net result and the rate cannot be counted, so they are shown as a dash. Zero would mean the position holds nothing, and that is not so. What was put in is fixed on the day of the deal and stays exact.
cryptoTrack.positions.banner.approximate: The adapter says so together with the numbers (a Uniswap v4 pool behind a hook can change what it owes on every trade). The screen does not decide it itself. What was put in and the gas stay exact.
cryptoTrack.positions.banner.closedTitle: The position is closed: the numbers are frozen
cryptoTrack.positions.banner.closed: The liquidity is out. The position stays in the history and is not polled any more; it is not part of the current worth of the portfolio, only of the net result.
cryptoTrack.positions.breakdown.title: How the net result is made up
cryptoTrack.positions.breakdown.noteIl: Against simply holding: {il} ({ratio}), for reference. It is already inside the price change and is not a line of the sum.
cryptoTrack.positions.breakdown.noteNoIl: Against simply holding: not known for this position. Reference only; it is never a line of the sum.
cryptoTrack.positions.breakdown.noteAccr: A supply or a stake has no pair of coins, so there is no loss against holding and no pool fees: a dash, not zero. The accrual is already inside the worth and is shown on its own line, once.
cryptoTrack.positions.side.pool.title: Pool fees
cryptoTrack.positions.side.pool.note: Fees can only be collected in the wallet or in the protocol app: the application reads positions and signs nothing.
cryptoTrack.positions.side.lending.title: Loan and supply
cryptoTrack.positions.side.lending.note: The worth is the supply minus the debt. Repaying or topping up can only be done in the wallet: the application reads positions and signs nothing.
cryptoTrack.positions.side.staking.title: Staking
cryptoTrack.positions.side.staking.note: The reward arrives by rebase: the balance grows on its own, so the accrual is already inside the worth.
